en-US.author: t8y2
en-US.description: 15MB，lightweight, cross-platform database client. Supports MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, Redis, MongoDB, DuckDB, ClickHouse, SQL Server and more.
en-US.name: DBX
en-US.releaseNotes:
What's Changed
- fix(mysql): 按需加载对象详情和数据库容量，避免元数据阻塞浏览 by @CN-Scars in #14189
- fix(sql-file): keep the execution dialog open by default on success by @ericbyz in #14145
- fix(settings): simplify tab appearance options layout by @zipg in #14160
- fix(sidebar): let visible database wildcards work without checked databases by @seaways1015-afk in #14245
- fix(mysql): update driver dependency for Router authentication by @CN-Scars in #14247
- feat(kingbase): support manual/autocommit toggle in the SQL editor by @Gaiokane in #14249
- fix(postgres): create exported views after the views they read by @jeff377 in #14248
- fix(redis): avoid O(N^2) line offsets and viewport-bound diagnostics on large scripts (#14154) by @onenewcode in #14227
- fix(postgres): stop re-quoting an already delimited identifier by @xiaou61 in #14237
- fix(postgres): preserve loaded tree range when reopening by @CN-Scars in #14176
- fix(sqlserver): send a usable port and stop pinning a cleared one by @xiaou61 in #14242
- fix(objects): 修复对象预览 DDL 搜索回车定位 by @liuchaowu12 in #14246
- fix(sidebar): resolve table-vgroup scope for search-projected rows by @caiyq925-cell in #14250
- fix(connection): support official Databend DSNs by @wubx in #14268
- fix(editor): expand accepted snippets on every rectangular cursor by @Tong-bit-art in #14118
- feat(desktop): refresh sidebar when another process rewrites the layout by @reginaldoroge in #13607
- fix(generate): honour the declared column type when picking a generator by @yiqiui in #13014
- feat(editor): support configurable completion match mode by @zhongtait in #13833
- fix(sidebar): scope Ctrl+F table search to active database (#9739) by @lxk955 in #11522
- fix(mysql): 拒绝为引用会话变量的查询生成 COUNT 统计，避免「总计 0 行」 by @dienaso in #14005
- feat(connection): sync configured colors in connection picker by @imcman in #14256
- fix(gaussdb): load routine source with empty signatures by @imcman in #14224
- feat(grid): copy SQL from quick query controls by @Acd-kk in #14203
- fix(starrocks): show indexes in the table structure editor by @seaways1015-afk in #14124
- fix(grid): show column comments for aggregate result labels by @davids-dot in #14253
- fix(sidebar): use opaque background for hover reveal by @r9yn in #14234
- fix(zookeeper): route all ensemble endpoints through transports by @CN-Scars in #14287
- fix(firebird): place column defaults before NOT NULL in Java agent table DDL by @lcq928 in #14302
- fix(postgres): 修复全库导出的跨 schema 视图依赖顺序 by @CN-Scars in #14292
- fix(oracle): save grid edits to the table behind a public synonym (Fixes #14231) by @jeff377 in #14301
- fix(plugin): stop routing marketplace downloads through the stats worker by @yyn0210 in #14255
- fix(backup): 网络文件系统重挂载后放宽目标目录身份校验 by @dienaso in #14020
- feat(export): 导出选表支持逗号分隔表名批量勾选和正则筛选 by @chukui2005 in #14293
New Contributors
- @liuchaowu12 made their first contribution in #14246
- @wubx made their first contribution in #14268
- @reginaldoroge made their first contribution in #13607
- @davids-dot made their first contribution in #14253
- @yyn0210 made their first contribution in #14255
